# fundament_project (Resource)

Manages a project in Fundament.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fundament_project" "example" {
  name         = "my-project"
  cluster_name = "my-cluster"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the project. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `alias` (String) The human-readable label for the project. Can be updated without recreating the project.
- `cluster_id` (String) The ID of the cluster this project belongs to. Either cluster_id or cluster_name must be specified, but not both.
- `cluster_name` (String) The name of the cluster this project belongs to. Either cluster_id or cluster_name must be specified, but not both.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) The timestamp when the project was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the project.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import fundament_project.example <project-id>
```
